_doc: Outstanding bond data + indicative yields for CA NH muni 'clean basket' obligors. CUSIPs were NOT retrievable through public web (EMMA blocks programmatic search) — leave arrays empty rather than fabricate. Yields are estimated from rating + maturity + Bond Buyer / Tradeweb MMD AAA curve as of late May 2026.

mmd_aaa_anchor_curve_may_2026.source: MunicipalBonds.com California AAA yield curve + Tradeweb / Bond Buyer commentary 2026-05-26

spread_heuristics_used.AA_minus_cal_mortgage_insured_30yr: +30 to +60 bps (insurance wrap to state AA- credit)
spread_heuristics_used.private_placement_or_unrated_with_SNF: +250 to +400 bps; often illiquid, indicative only

methodology_notes.cusip_strategy: EMMA blocks scraping; CUSIPs not in public news releases. Leaving cusips=[] is honest; investor can pull from EMMA manually via obligor search once leads identified here.

outstanding_bonds.use_of_proceeds: Cap-ex / renovations across 13 of 14 campuses (elevators, HVAC, roofs, generators, plumbing)

outstanding_bonds.coupons_range: fixed rate, 7yr interest-only then level debt service
outstanding_bonds.use_of_proceeds: Refund Series 2015 Bonds, refund 2015 Bank Loan, costs of issuance

outstanding_bonds.series: CMFA Revenue Bonds (TEFRA-approved, not yet issued / partial draw)
outstanding_bonds.use_of_proceeds: Plymouth Village (Redlands) upgrades + other HGCOG cap-ex; TEFRA approved by Redlands City Council June 3, 2025
outstanding_bonds.status: Authorization up to $205M; pricing TBD or staggered

indicative_yield.spread_methodology: Fitch A senior living CCRC obligated group, 20yr maturity. MMD AAA 20yr ~4.10% + ~70-90 bps for A-rated muti-campus CCRC obligated group = 4.80-5.00%. Series 2021 (A-) likely 25-50 bps wider than Series 2025A.

HumanGood California Obligated Group._notes: By far the most institutional credit in this basket. Multiple bond fund holdings reference 'California State MFA Revenue HumanGood Obligated Group Series A Refunding 4.00% 10/1/39' indicating Series 2019A is widely held. Fitch upgrade to A in Dec 2024 should have driven spread tightening. Pending $205M Plymouth Village authorization is the catalyst to watch — primary market entry point likely 2026-2027.

obligated_group_members: Congregational Homes, Inc. dba Mt. San Antonio Gardens

outstanding_bonds.coupons_range: fixed rate tax-exempt; specific tiers not public
outstanding_bonds.use_of_proceeds: Replace original 'D Building' with 53-unit IL building 'The Cedars', subterranean parking, refinance prior debt

indicative_yield.spread_methodology: Unrated standalone single-site CCRC with SNF. MMD AAA 30yr ~4.40% + ~225-275 bps for unrated single-site obligor = 6.65-7.15%. Likely thinly traded or held by specialty senior-living muni funds (e.g., Ziegler-affiliated). Could be priced wider if SNF mix is meaningful share of revenue.

Mount San Antonio Gardens (Congregationa._notes: Standalone unrated CCRC. Construction-period bonds from 2022 — bond market sentiment has worsened materially since issuance (rates higher, sector defaults at 8-10%). Indicative yield is a model estimate; could trade 50-100 bps wider in low-bid scenarios. Likely no recent public trade data available; EMMA search by 'Congregational Homes' or 'Mt. San Antonio Gardens' would surface CUSIPs.

outstanding_bonds.insurance: Cal-Mortgage Loan Insurance Program (HCAI / state AA- credit)
outstanding_bonds.use_of_proceeds: Construct 35-unit RCFE expansion; refund Series 2015A bonds; ~26 months capitalized interest; DSRF; bond insurance premium; COI

indicative_yield.spread_methodology: Cal-Mortgage insured = effectively State of California AA- credit. MMD AAA 30yr ~4.40% + ~35-55 bps for AA- insured = 4.75-4.95%. Insurance wrap means trading levels track CalHFA / Cal-Mortgage AA- comparables, not single-site CCRC underlying.

Aldersly (Garden Retirement Community)._notes: Cal-Mortgage insurance is the punchline here — investor is buying State of California AA- credit risk, not the underlying single-site CCRC. Construction-period (capitalized interest 26 months) so cash-flow stress is intentionally deferred — watch 2025-2026 for transition to debt service from operations. Newer issue (June 2023) so should have moderate secondary float.

O'Connor Woods Housing Corp.fitch_rating: Unrated (likely Fitch BBB at obligated group level if part of Eskaton, but O'Connor Woods is operated by Eskaton, NOT part of Eskaton Obligated Group)
obligated_group_members: O'Connor Woods Housing Corporation (standalone, operated by Eskaton)

outstanding_bonds.coupons_range: fixed rate tax-exempt; specific tiers not public
outstanding_bonds.insurance: Cal-Mortgage Loan Insurance Program (commitment issued 2021-08-02; bondholder CalPFA payment date 2022-10-31 per HCAI Cal-Mortgage Monthly Activity Report)

indicative_yield.spread_methodology: If Cal-Mortgage insured as HCAI report suggests, trades to AA- insured curve = MMD 30yr 4.40% + ~35-55 bps. If actually private placement / unrated direct loan, could be 5.50-6.50% in current rate regime. Confidence is low because public disclosure is thin.

O'Connor Woods Housing Corp._notes: IMPORTANT correction: Eskaton Obligated Group Series 2024 ($82.895M, BBB Fitch, CMFA, 2044 maturity) consists of Eskaton Properties (Carmichael, Land Park, Gold River) + 2 others — does NOT appear to include O'Connor Woods. O'Connor Woods Housing Corp is a separate 501(c)(3) operated by Eskaton with its own ~$46.5M CalPFA 2021 Cal-Mortgage insured deal. Verify by pulling Form 990 Schedule K (tax-exempt bond debt detail) from ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer — that will confirm conduit issuer, CUSIPs, and outstanding par. This obligor is least transparent of the five.

obligated_group_members: Bethany Home Society of San Joaquin County, Inc.

outstanding_bonds.coupons_range: fixed rate tax-exempt; 30yr final maturity, level debt service
outstanding_bonds.use_of_proceeds: Finance $61M campus expansion: The Terraces at Bethany (82 new IL units, 25,000 sf amenity space, 3-story 104,700 sf building); construction began June 2023; opened ~April-June 2025

indicative_yield.spread_methodology: Same Cal-Mortgage AA- wrap as Aldersly. MMD AAA 30yr 4.40% + ~35-55 bps = 4.75-4.95%. Bethany has 4-star CMS rating (strongest of basket) so unsecured/uninsured implied yield would be ~6-6.5%; insurance is the bid-side compression.

Bethany Home Society of San Joaquin Coun._notes: Same structural story as Aldersly: Cal-Mortgage insured = State AA- credit. The Terraces expansion opened May/June 2025, so 2025-2026 are the fill-up risk years. CMS 4-star rating + faith-based donor base provide additional credit support outside the insurance wrap. Should be the safest 'clean basket' name on underlying credit even before insurance.

summary.obligor_with_most_accessible_secondary_m: HumanGood California Obligated Group — multiple bond series ($141.7M 2019A, $16.8M 2019B, $120M 2021, $67.23M 2025A), widely held by California muni funds (Nuveen NCA, Legg Mason, Thornburg per NPORT-P filings), Fitch A rated, with one fund-disclosed line: 'California State MFA Revenue HumanGood Obligated Group Series A Refunding 4.00% 10/1/2039'. Has actual fund-disclosed pricing references.
